# Gemini thinking

## Controlling thinking  {% id="levels-budgets" %}

### Thinking levels (Gemini 4 and Gemini 3)  {% id="thinking-levels" %}

The `thinkingLevel` parameter controls reasoning behavior.

{% table %}
  * Model
  * Default thinking
  * Levels supported

  ---

  * gemini-4-carbon
  * On (medium)
  * low, medium, high

  ---

  * gemini-3.8-flash
  * On (medium)
  * low, medium, high
{% /table %}
